name: Brandon M. Tesser
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Los Angeles, California
side_practice_areas: Business Litigation, Employment & Labor, Entertainment & Sports
about: Attorney Brandon Tesser is the managing partner and a co-founder of the law firm of Tesser | Grossman LLP, in Los Angeles, California. Mr. Tesser represents clients throughout Los Angeles County in matters involving business, employment and entertainment litigation and appeals, personal injury, sexual harassment and more. His clients include individuals and corporations. Many of his clients are involved in the entertainment industry.

Mr. Tesser graduated from the University of California, Santa Barbara, and earned his law degree from Loyola Law School, Los Angeles. Before entering private practice, he gained legal experience by serving as a judicial extern to two judges.

Admitted to practice in the state of California since 1993, Mr. Tesser has over two decades of legal experience and has helped his clients to recover verdicts and settlements in excess of $1 million several times over the course of his career. He has been involved in many high-profile cases and has earned a reputation among his peers and clients as an innovative and committed advocate.

Along with managing his law practice Mr. Tesser is a fee arbitrator for the Los Angeles County Bar Association. He is also active in his local and state legal community, belonging to professional organizations, including the Santa Monica Bar Association and the State Bar of California.

Additional organizations Mr. Tesser belongs to include the Consumer Attorneys Association of Los Angeles and the Association of Surfing Lawyers. He is also a member of ProVisors, an organization comprised of professionals who share the goal of providing knowledgeable and informed advice to their clients.
honors: “Rising Star” by the California Super Lawyers
